newsitem.title: USA: Medarex' product shows anti-tumor effects.
newsitem.headline: Medarex' product shows anti-tumor effects.

text.p: Medarex Inc said Monday its anti-cancer product MDX-210 showed significant anti-tumor effects in trials.
The company said in interim results of two Phase H clinical studies of four kidney cancer patients who had advanced metastatic disease, two patients treated achieved a response.
One patient had a large liver tumor reduced by 54 percent and another patient had pulmonary metastases reduced by 49 percent, Medarex said.

Separately, Medarex said a prostate cancer patient with advanced metastatic disease experienced a drop in his serum prostate specific antigen measurement of more than 90 percent in another Phase II trial. This prostate cancer study will involve 15 patients, four of which have been reported at this time, the company said.
The results were announced at the 5th International Bispecific Antibody Conference in Volendam, the Netherlands, on June 28, Medarex said.

The biopharmaceutical company reported a loss of $13.2 million, or $0.71 a share, in the first quarter, compared with a loss of $1.7 million, or $0.14 a share, the year before. Its stock traded at 6-3/8 Monday morning, up 3/16.
